keyPhrases.text: This brilliant Enemy of the People
notably funny in both its smarts and pacing
pleasure of watching a lean, focused Strong perform
excellent, the most adept scene-stealer on Broadway right now
Such uncertainty, or sense of shifting positions, is missing from this adaptation

reasoning: Strong positive review with enthusiastic praise ('brilliant', 'wonderfully', 'excellent') and detailed appreciation of performances and direction. One minor criticism about missing ambiguity, but overall tone is highly favorable and recommending.
